notes: Access: plain curl_cffi (chrome131 impersonation) direct HTTP fetch throughout, no block encountered (robots.txt group for ClaudeBot is 'Allow: / / Disallow: /*+*', consistent with prior Home-Decor pass notes). Discovery: fetched sitemap_2-category.xml (2189 category URLs) and grepped for bestseller/popularity keywords, cross-checked against homepage mega-nav HTML (no 'Best Sellers'/'Popular'/'Top Sellers' text in the visible top nav itself - these listings are not in the primary mega-menu, only reachable via direct URL / sitemap / footer-style links) and the site's Gift-Guide hub family. Site platform is Salesforce Commerce Cloud + Constructor.io (same as prior pass); qty taken from the rendered N-Results header, which is identical to the page's data-cnstrc-num-results attribute - this exact mechanism was exhaustion-tested against 10 categories spanning 5 to 8,675 items in the prior Home-Decor/Lighting pass on this same site and proven exact every time, so it is trusted here without re-running a full exhaustion crawl. Three genuinely different Bestsellers-type listings found (different URLs, different product sets/counts - kept as separate rows per the multiple-PLP rule, none are aliases of each other): (1) /best-sellers/ - the core, unambiguous 'Best Sellers' PLP. (2) /20-customer-favorites/ - part of a recurring '20-X' curated-list template on this site (siblings include /20-new-arrivals/, /20-top-searched-products/, /20-iconic-designs/); title says '20' but the live page only renders 6 products - qty is exact for what's currently live, just smaller than the page's nominal name. Uses the literal target term 'Customer Favorites'. (3) /gift-guide-top-selling-gifts/ - a genuine PLP (same plp-page.css template, real product-tile grid, meta keywords 'top selling gifts, best selling gifts, best selling modern gifts') but scoped to Lumens' Gift Guide family (siblings: Gifts Under $20, Gifts For Him, etc.) rather than the core Bestsellers taxonomy branch, so flagged for review. EXCLUDED after inspection: /20-top-searched-products/ (search-query popularity, not sales/purchase popularity - doesn't match any Bestsellers target term); the rest of the Gift Guide family (curated by price/recipient, no bestseller signal). No local-language search needed (US/English-only site). Website search itself was not queried (robots.txt Disallow: /search* applies to the generic '*' agent group; sitemap + full mega-nav text scan already surfaced every bestseller-shaped candidate, so search would add no new discovery).
